reference_sql:
SELECT channel,
       COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders,
       SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS net_sales_eur,
       ROUND(SUM(net_revenue_eur) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 2) AS aov_eur,
       ROUND(SUM(units) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 2) AS units_per_order
FROM sales
WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-01' AND DATE '2025-11-30'
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY channel
alternatives: SELECT channel, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS net_sales_eur, ROUND(SUM(net_revenue_eur) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 2) AS aov_eur, ROUND(CAST(SUM(units) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 2) AS units_per_order FROM sales WHERE order_month = DATE '2025-11-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT channel, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS net_sales_eur, ROUND(SUM(net_revenue_eur) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 2) AS aov_eur, ROUND(SUM(units) / CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)), 2) AS units_per_order FROM sales WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-11-01' AND order_date < DATE '2025-12-01' GROUP BY channel ORDER BY channel ASC
